words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 真的吗？太令人惊喜了！(Zhēn de ma? Tài lìngrén jīngxǐ le!) — Really? That is so wonderful and surprising!
当然可以，随时欢迎你来！(Dāngrán kěyǐ, suíshí huānyíng nǐ lái!) — Of course, you are welcome to come anytime!
包在我身上，没问题！(Bāo zài wǒ shēnshang, méi wèntí!) — Leave it to me, no problem!

words.English Meaning: forget it / let it go / drop it
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 既然下雨了，算了吧，改天再去。(Jìrán xiàyǔ le, suàn le ba, gǎitiān zài qù.) — Since it's raining, let it go, we'll go another day.
中午吃什么？我都行，随便你。(Zhōngwǔ chī shénme? Wǒ dōu xíng, suíbiàn nǐ.) — What to eat for lunch? I'm good with anything, up to you.
麻烦您帮我递一下那本书。(Máfan nín bāng wǒ dì yíxià nà běn shū.) — Trouble you to pass me that book, please.

words.English Meaning: excuse me / sorry to bother / embarrassed
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 不好意思，借过一下。(Bù hǎoyìsi, jièguò yíxià.) — Excuse me, pardon me coming through.
你放心，我一定会按时把事情办好。(Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ yídìng huì ànshí bǎ shìqing bàn hǎo.) — Rest assured, I will definitely get it done on time.

words.English Meaning: keep it up! / cheer on! / go for it!
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 考试别紧张，加油！(Kǎoshì bié jǐnzhāng, jiāyóu!) — Don't be nervous about the exam, cheer up and do your best!
恭喜你顺利通过了汉语水平考试！(Gōngxǐ nǐ shùnlì tōngguò le Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì!) — Congratulations on successfully passing the HSK exam!

words.English Meaning: thank you for your hard work / you've worked hard
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 今天大家辛苦了，早点回家休息吧。(Jīntiān dàjiā xīnkǔ le, zǎodiǎn huíjiā xiūxi ba.) — Thank you everyone for your hard work today, go home early and rest.
学中文不用着急，慢慢来。(Xué Zhōngwén bú yòng zháojí, mànman lái.) — No need to rush learning Chinese, take your time.
你脸色不太好，怎么了？(Nǐ liǎnsè bú tài hǎo, zěnme le?) — You don't look well, what's the matter?

words.English Meaning: to joke / to make fun of / just kidding
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 别当真，我只是跟你开玩笑。(Bié dàngzhēn, wǒ zhǐshì gēn nǐ kāiwánxiào.) — Don't take it seriously, I was just kidding with you.
你的中文说得太厉害了！(Nǐ de Zhōngwén shuō de tài lìhai le!) — Your spoken Chinese is truly impressive!
这部电影拍得确实非常感人。(Zhè bù diànyǐng pāi de quèshí fēicháng gǎnrén.) — This movie was indeed filmed very touchingly.
我的工作差不多全部做完了。(Wǒ de gōngzuò chàbuduō quánbù zuò wán le.) — My work is almost completely done.
原来是你啊，我还以为是谁呢！(Yuánlái shì nǐ a, wǒ hái yǐwéi shì shéi ne!) — So it was you! I was wondering who it was!
其实学汉字并没有想象中那么难。(Qíshí xué hànzì bìng méiyǒu xiǎngxiàng zhōng nàme nán.) — Actually learning characters isn't as hard as imagined.
另外，请记得明天带上护照复印件。(Lìngwài, qǐng jìde míngtiān dài shàng hùzhào fùyìnjiàn.) — In addition, please remember to bring a passport copy tomorrow.
外面突然下起了大雨。(Wàimiàn tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ.) — Suddenly it started pouring rain outside.
经过努力，我们终于完成了任务。(Jīngguò nǔlì, wǒmen zhōngyú wánchéng le rènwu.) — Through hard work, we finally accomplished the mission.

words.English Meaning: conveniently / in passing / by the way
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 你去超市时顺便帮我买瓶牛奶吧。(Nǐ qù chāoshì shí shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi píng niúnǎi ba.) — When you go to the store, grab me a bottle of milk while you're at it.

words.English Meaning: no matter what / in any case
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 无论如何，我们都要试一试。(Wúlùn rúhé, wǒmen dōu yào shì yí shì.) — No matter what, we must give it a try.

words.English Meaning: make yourself at home / sit wherever you like
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 快请进，家里有点乱，随便坐！(Kuài qǐng jìn, jiālǐ yǒudiǎn luàn, suíbiàn zuò!) — Please come in, house is a bit messy, have a seat anywhere!
